hyderabad.name: Hyderabad
hyderabad.intro: Hyderabad is one of India's busiest event cities, with celebrations spread from function halls in Secunderabad and the old city to convention centres, resorts and farmhouses on the outskirts.

tips.general: Traffic across Hyderabad can change set-up timings sharply, so ask each vendor how they plan transport and crew arrival for your venue and date.
tips.tent: Many venues sit far from the city centre; confirm delivery and labour charges when your venue is a long way from the vendor's godown.
tips.catering: Ask whether the caterer has worked at your venue before and what the venue's rules are on outside kitchens, gas and water.

visakhapatnam.name: Visakhapatnam
visakhapatnam.intro: Visakhapatnam, known as Vizag, hosts weddings and functions in its coastal function halls, kalyana mandapams, hotels and open grounds along the beach road.

tips.general: Coastal weather can change quickly, so ask vendors about waterproof cover and backup plans for open-air set-ups.
tips.tent: Sea breeze and humidity affect tent fabric and decor; ask vendors for materials suited to coastal conditions.

kolkata.name: Kolkata
kolkata.intro: Kolkata's celebrations range from traditional Bengali weddings in community halls to large banquets in Salt Lake and New Town, with decorators and caterers known for regional specialities.

tips.general: Confirm venue rules on outside caterers and decorators well in advance; some community halls have fixed vendor panels.

berhampur.name: Berhampur
berhampur.intro: Berhampur, also called Brahmapur, is the main commercial centre of Ganjam district in southern Odisha, where Odia and Telugu communities both celebrate weddings and festivals.

tips.general: If your ceremonies follow a particular community tradition, tell vendors early so rituals, music and food are planned around it.

srikakulam.name: Srikakulam
srikakulam.intro: Srikakulam district in north coastal Andhra Pradesh hosts weddings and family functions in kalyana mandapams and function halls, with vendors serving both the town and surrounding mandals.

tips.general: For events in small towns and villages, ask vendors about travel and set-up time; some may need to arrive a day early.

sambalpur.name: Sambalpur
sambalpur.intro: Sambalpur, in western Odisha on the Mahanadi, hosts weddings and community functions in its function halls and open grounds, with a strong tradition of local cuisine and decor.

tips.general: For events near Hirakud or Burla, ask vendors about travel distance and set-up logistics.

guntur.name: Guntur
guntur.intro: Guntur is a busy commercial centre, and families from the city and surrounding towns hold weddings and community events in its function halls, kalyana mandapams and open grounds.

tips.general: If your event is in a town around Guntur rather than the city itself, ask vendors about travel charges and whether the crew can arrive the day before.
tips.decor: Before you book, check what your function hall allows for hanging decor, open flame and flower installations.

chittoor.name: Chittoor
chittoor.intro: Chittoor district in southern Andhra Pradesh hosts weddings and family functions in town halls and kalyana mandapams, with many events linked to temple towns nearby.

tips.general: Events near temple towns may follow specific ritual timings; share the schedule with all vendors early.

vijayawada.name: Vijayawada
vijayawada.intro: Vijayawada, on the banks of the Krishna, is a major event city with function halls, kalyana mandapams and convention centres spread across Benz Circle, Labbipet and the outskirts.

tips.general: Peak wedding months fill popular venues fast; book the venue and caterer first, then plan decor around them.

indore.name: Indore
indore.intro: Indore, in central India, hosts a wide range of weddings, corporate events and festivals in its convention centres, hotels and community halls.

tips.general: Check venue rules on amplified sound and timing; some city zones restrict music after certain hours.

nellore.name: Nellore
nellore.intro: Nellore, in southern coastal Andhra Pradesh, hosts weddings and functions in its function halls, kalyana mandapams and open grounds, and many families also book vendors for events in nearby towns.

tips.general: For events outside the city limits, ask vendors about delivery distance, extra labour and whether the quote includes transport both ways.
tips.tent: Coastal weather can turn quickly; ask for waterproof roofing and a drainage plan for any open-ground set-up.

navi-mumbai.name: Navi Mumbai
navi-mumbai.intro: Navi Mumbai's planned layout includes convention centres, hotels and community halls in Vashi, Nerul and Kharghar, well-suited to corporate events and large weddings.

tips.general: Traffic between Navi Mumbai and Mumbai can affect vendor arrival; share the venue address and expected set-up time well ahead.

mumbai.name: Mumbai
mumbai.intro: Mumbai's event scene spans heritage banquet halls in South Mumbai, hotels and convention centres in the suburbs, and open grounds across the city.

tips.general: Parking and traffic are major constraints; choose vendors who know your venue and can arrive early for set-up.
tips.catering: Ask about kitchen access at your venue; some hotels restrict outside caterers and require in-house catering.

bhubaneswar.name: Bhubaneswar
bhubaneswar.intro: Bhubaneswar, Odisha's capital, hosts weddings and events in its hotels, convention centres and community halls, with vendors serving both the city and nearby Cuttack.

tips.general: For events in the twin-city area around Cuttack, confirm which vendor network covers your venue.

cuttack.name: Cuttack
cuttack.intro: Cuttack, the former capital of Odisha, hosts traditional weddings and community functions in its function halls and kalyana mandapams.

tips.general: Cuttack and Bhubaneswar are close enough that many vendors serve both; ask which side of the river they are based on.

rourkela.name: Rourkela
rourkela.intro: Rourkela, in Odisha's Sundargarh district, hosts weddings and events connected to its steel plant community, with vendors serving the township and surrounding areas.

tips.general: If your venue is inside the steel township, check visitor and vendor access rules in advance.

siddipet.name: Siddipet
siddipet.intro: Siddipet, in northern Telangana, hosts weddings and family functions in its function halls and kalyana mandapams, with many events linked to nearby villages.

tips.general: For events in nearby villages, ask vendors about travel time and whether they can set up the previous day.

nizamabad.name: Nizamabad
nizamabad.intro: Nizamabad, in northern Telangana, hosts weddings and community functions in its function halls and open grounds, with a mix of urban and rural celebrations.

tips.general: During peak agricultural seasons, vendor availability can be limited; book early.

mahbubnagar.name: Mahbubnagar
mahbubnagar.intro: Mahbubnagar, in southern Telangana, hosts weddings and family events in its function halls and kalyana mandapams.

tips.general: The district is large; confirm the exact venue location with vendors to avoid travel surprises.

khammam.name: Khammam
khammam.intro: Khammam, in eastern Telangana, hosts weddings and functions in its function halls and community centres, with vendors serving the town and surrounding mandals.

tips.general: For events in nearby Kothagudem or Palwancha, confirm travel charges in advance.

tenali.name: Tenali
tenali.intro: Tenali, in Andhra Pradesh's Guntur district, is known for its cultural heritage and hosts weddings and family functions in traditional kalyana mandapams.

tips.general: Many Tenali vendors also serve Guntur and Vijayawada; ask which areas they cover regularly.

karimnagar.name: Karimnagar
karimnagar.intro: Karimnagar, in northern Telangana, hosts weddings and family events in its function halls and community centres.

tips.general: Confirm venue rules on outside vendors and timing restrictions before booking decorators.

warangal.name: Warangal
warangal.intro: Warangal and its twin city Hanamkonda host weddings, cultural events and family functions in function halls and community centres across the region.

tips.general: Warangal, Hanamkonda and Kazipet are close together; clarify the venue location with each vendor to plan set-up.

hanamkonda.name: Hanamkonda
hanamkonda.intro: Hanamkonda, part of the Warangal urban area, hosts weddings and community events in local function halls.

tips.general: Most Hanamkonda vendors also serve Warangal and Kazipet; ask about coverage area.

adilabad.name: Adilabad
adilabad.intro: Adilabad, in northern Telangana, hosts weddings and family functions in its function halls and community centres.

tips.general: Some venues are a long drive from the nearest town; confirm vendor travel time in advance.

nirmal.name: Nirmal
nirmal.intro: Nirmal, in northern Telangana, hosts weddings and family functions in local function halls.

tips.general: For village events in the district, ask vendors about travel time and set-up on the previous day.

nalgonda.name: Nalgonda
nalgonda.intro: Nalgonda, in southern Telangana, hosts weddings and family functions in its function halls and open grounds.

tips.general: For events in smaller towns of the district, ask vendors whether they can set up the day before.

pune.name: Pune
pune.intro: Pune hosts weddings and corporate events in hotels, convention centres and heritage venues, with vendors serving both the city and nearby hill stations.

tips.general: For events in Lonavala, Mahabaleshwar or other hill venues, plan travel and set-up early.

ncr.name: NCR
ncr.intro: Delhi NCR encompasses Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Faridabad and Ghaziabad, and hosts events of every scale, from heritage venues in Delhi to large convention centres in the suburbs.

tips.general: Distances within NCR can be deceptive; confirm which city the vendor is based in and plan travel accordingly.

balasore.name: Balasore
balasore.intro: Balasore, in coastal Odisha, hosts weddings and family functions in its function halls and community centres.

tips.general: Coastal weather can affect outdoor set-ups; ask vendors about waterproof cover.

bargarh.name: Bargarh
bargarh.intro: Bargarh, in western Odisha, hosts weddings and community functions in its function halls and open grounds.

tips.general: For village events in the district, ask vendors about travel time and crew availability.

nabarangpur.name: Nabarangpur
nabarangpur.intro: Nabarangpur, in southern Odisha, hosts weddings and family functions in local function halls and community centres.

tips.general: For events in remote parts of the district, confirm vendor travel and set-up time early.

rayagada.name: Rayagada
rayagada.intro: Rayagada, in southern Odisha, hosts weddings and community functions in its function halls.

tips.general: Some vendors based in Bhubaneswar or Visakhapatnam serve Rayagada; confirm travel charges.

bhadrak.name: Bhadrak
bhadrak.intro: Bhadrak, in coastal Odisha, hosts weddings and family functions in local function halls.

tips.general: Confirm whether vendors are based in Bhadrak or travel from Bhubaneswar or Cuttack.

keonjhar.name: Keonjhar
keonjhar.intro: Keonjhar (Kendujhar) in northern Odisha hosts weddings and community functions in local function halls.

tips.general: The district is large and includes mining towns; confirm venue location with vendors.

jagatsinghpur.name: Jagatsinghpur
jagatsinghpur.intro: Jagatsinghpur, in coastal Odisha near Cuttack, hosts weddings and family functions in local function halls.

tips.general: Most events here are family-scale; ask vendors about minimum booking sizes.

paralakhemundi.name: Paralakhemundi
paralakhemundi.intro: Paralakhemundi, in southern Odisha near the Andhra border, hosts weddings and family functions in local function halls.

tips.general: Vendors may be based in Srikakulam or Berhampur; confirm travel charges.

burla.name: Burla
burla.intro: Burla, adjacent to Sambalpur in western Odisha, hosts weddings and community events in local function halls.

tips.general: Most Burla vendors also serve Sambalpur and Hirakud; ask about coverage.

chatrapur.name: Chatrapur
chatrapur.intro: Chatrapur, the headquarters of Ganjam district in Odisha, hosts weddings and family functions in local function halls.

tips.general: Most vendors serving Chatrapur are also based in or travel from Berhampur.

ganjam.name: Ganjam
ganjam.intro: Ganjam district in southern Odisha hosts weddings and family functions in local function halls and kalyana mandapams.

tips.general: For village events, confirm vendor travel time and set-up schedule in advance.

palasa.name: Palasa
palasa.intro: Palasa, in Srikakulam district of Andhra Pradesh, hosts weddings and family functions in local function halls.

tips.general: Most vendors serving Palasa are also based in Srikakulam or Berhampur.

narasannapeta.name: Narasannapeta
narasannapeta.intro: Narasannapeta, in Srikakulam district, hosts weddings and family functions in local function halls.

tips.general: Confirm whether vendors travel from Srikakulam or are based locally.

tadepalli.name: Tadepalli
tadepalli.intro: Tadepalli, near Vijayawada in Andhra Pradesh, hosts weddings and family events in local function halls.

tips.general: Most vendors serving Tadepalli are based in Vijayawada or Guntur.

venkatagirikota.name: Venkatagirikota
venkatagirikota.intro: Venkatagirikota, in Chittoor district, hosts weddings and family functions in local function halls.

tips.general: For village events, confirm vendor travel and set-up timing.

kovur.name: Kovur
kovur.intro: Kovur, near Nellore in Andhra Pradesh, hosts weddings and family functions in local function halls.

tips.general: Most vendors serving Kovur are based in Nellore.

narakoduru.name: Narakoduru
narakoduru.intro: Narakoduru, in Nellore district, hosts weddings and family functions in local venues.

tips.general: For village events, confirm vendor travel and set-up timing.

ponnur.name: Ponnur
ponnur.intro: Ponnur, in Guntur district, hosts weddings and family functions in local function halls.

tips.general: Most vendors serving Ponnur are based in Guntur or Tenali.

singupuram.name: Singupuram
singupuram.intro: Singupuram, in Srikakulam district, hosts weddings and family functions in local venues.

tips.general: For village events, confirm vendor travel and set-up timing.

surada.name: Surada
surada.intro: Surada, in Ganjam district of Odisha, hosts weddings and family functions in local function halls.

tips.general: Most vendors serving Surada travel from Berhampur.

digapahandi.name: Digapahandi
digapahandi.intro: Digapahandi, in Ganjam district, hosts weddings and family functions in local function halls.

tips.general: Most vendors serving Digapahandi travel from Berhampur.

patrapur.name: Patrapur
patrapur.intro: Patrapur, in Ganjam district, hosts weddings and family functions in local venues.

tips.general: For village events, confirm vendor travel and set-up timing.
